hyperedges.label: Dark/Light Mode Flip System
hyperedges.description: All these elements participate in the coordinated dark/light mode switching system. Design tokens flip via CSS variables, BRLogo auto-swaps SVGs, BRBackground flips overlay color, Mermaid re-renders with mode-appropriate palette, Shiki switches themes.

hyperedges.label: Three-Layer Brand Color System
hyperedges.description: The three-layer color system (CSS variables, UnoCSS utilities, Slidev themeConfig) is consumed by all branded components. Design tokens at the base, UnoCSS wrapping them, components consuming utilities.

hyperedges.label: Cover Layout Assembly
hyperedges.description: The cover layout assembles BRLogo, BRBackground (optional), and responds to dark/light mode for overlay and logo variant selection.
